Gets the SCIM Group details for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/userconfig/v1/customers/:customerId/scimgroup/:scimGroupId

Gets the SCIM Group details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

scimGroupId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the SCIM Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
allEntries
boolean

Return all SCIM groups including the deleted ones if set to true

Default value: false
